assessment_metadata.name: CyberPath Risk Score - Comprehensive Cyber Insurance Risk Assessment
assessment_metadata.author: CyberPath Belfast
assessment_metadata.data_source: Based on 100+ Belfast SME security assessments (2022-2024)

scoring_model.methodology: Weighted actuarial model based on insurance claim data

questions.text: What is your primary industry sector?
How many employees does your company have?
What is your approximate annual revenue?
What types of sensitive data do you handle? (Select all that apply)
What percentage of your workforce is remote?
Current annual cyber insurance premium (optional - helps calculate savings)
Do you have a dedicated IT/Security team?

options.label: IT team but no security specialist

questions.text: Do you perform regular backups of critical systems?

options.label: No regular backups
options.breach_data: 100% of ransomware victims without backups paid ransom or lost data

questions.text: When did you last TEST restoring from backup?
How do you manage security patches?
Do users have local admin rights?

options.label: Major breach/ransomware
options.breach_data: 2.3x more likely to be attacked again
